lines.zh: 别看我小，我游的路线是笔直的。
lines.en: Small as I am, I swim a perfectly straight line.

lines.zh: 珊瑚枝之间只留一条缝，刚好够我过。
lines.en: There is one gap between coral branches, exactly my width.

lines.zh: 我贴着礁石游，这样影子就不会暴露我。
lines.en: I hug the reef so my shadow gives nothing away.

lines.zh: 暖水推着我走，我只需要轻轻摆尾。
lines.en: Warm water carries me; I only flick my tail.

lines.zh: 我绕着那丛鹿角珊瑚转第三圈了。
lines.en: I circle that staghorn coral for the third time.

lines.zh: 前面那条大鱼搅起的沙，正好替我挡路。
lines.en: The big fish ahead stirs sand that hides my path.

lines.zh: 我们五条一起拐弯，没有一条撞上。
lines.en: Five of us turn together and not one collides.

lines.zh: 深度变了，光变蓝，我知道该往上一点。
lines.en: The light turns blue with depth; I rise a little.

lines.zh: 我游得慢，但我从不改方向。
lines.en: I swim slowly, but I never change course.

lines.zh: 水流把我的条纹晃成一片花。
lines.en: The current blurs my stripes into a flower.

lines.zh: 我宁愿绕远，也不从开阔水面直穿。
lines.en: I would rather go around than cross open water.

lines.zh: 礁顶太亮，我挑底下那条阴影走。
lines.en: The reef top is bright; I take the shadowed lane below.

lines.zh: 我的鳍太小，快起来全靠尾巴。
lines.en: My fins are tiny; speed comes entirely from my tail.

lines.zh: 跟着我，别掉队，暖流一散就找不回。
lines.en: Follow me, do not fall behind; once the warm current breaks we are lost.

lines.zh: 我贴着礁底游，避开顶上的光。
lines.en: I skim the reef floor, away from the light above.

lines.zh: 我转身时，条纹闪了一下。
lines.en: My stripes flash as I turn.

lines.zh: 我停在水里，让清洁虾替我理鳍。
lines.en: I hover and let the cleaner shrimp tend my fins.

lines.zh: 珊瑚的影子在我背上慢慢挪。
lines.en: The coral's shadow creeps slowly across my back.

lines.zh: 我数着眼前漂过的浮游，一、二、三。
lines.en: I count the plankton drifting past: one, two, three.

lines.zh: 小鱼要常常停下来，才显得端庄。
lines.en: A small fish must pause often to look dignified.

lines.zh: 我的橙和白今天特别亮，我自己也知道。
lines.en: My orange and white are bright today; I know it.

lines.zh: 礁洞里很安静，只有虾在敲壳。
lines.en: The reef hollow is quiet but for a shrimp tapping shell.

lines.zh: 我悬在珊瑚上方，装成一片叶子。
lines.en: I hang above the coral, still as a leaf.

lines.zh: 暖水海洋里连水都是温的，我有点困。
lines.en: Even the water is warm here; I am a little sleepy.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，让光照出侧面那条纹。
lines.en: I turn so the light catches the stripe on my flank.

lines.zh: 这一丛珊瑚是我的，我每天都回来。
lines.en: This coral clump is mine; I return daily to check it.

lines.zh: 我把嘴张合几次，其实什么都没吃。
lines.en: I open and close my mouth a few times, eating nothing.

lines.zh: 我的鳞上沾了一粒沙，我很在意。
lines.en: A grain of sand is stuck to my scales and it bothers me.

lines.zh: 这样静静地待着，大鱼就懒得追我。
lines.en: Staying still like this, big fish cannot be bothered to chase me.

lines.zh: 我听见礁外有浪，那声音离我很远。
lines.en: I hear surf beyond the reef, a sound very far away.

lines.zh: 你这么大一块，把我的光全挡住了。
lines.en: You are such a slab that you block all my light.

lines.zh: 你的护目镜里有两个我，一正一反。
lines.en: Two of me show in your goggles, one true and one reversed.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，我只是退到珊瑚后面观察。
lines.en: I am not afraid; I withdraw behind coral to observe.

lines.zh: 你手上那颗骨粉，气味很熟。
lines.en: The bone meal on your hand smells familiar.

lines.zh: 侏儒天使鱼也在看你，别以为只有你在看。
lines.en: The dwarf angelfish watches you too; do not think otherwise.

lines.zh: 你踩下来的影子比整丛珊瑚都大。
lines.en: Your falling shadow is larger than the whole coral clump.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛长在两侧，能一边逃一边看你。
lines.en: My eyes sit on both sides, so I can flee and watch you.

lines.zh: 你要是伸手，我就散成五条，你抓不全。
lines.en: Reach in and we scatter into five; you cannot catch all.

lines.zh: 我在你面前竖起来，是为了显得高一点。
lines.en: I rise before you to look a little taller.

lines.zh: 别敲玻璃，玻璃另一边也是海。
lines.en: Do not tap the glass; the sea is on that side too.

lines.zh: 我的鳍破了一角，游起来有点偏。
lines.en: A corner of my fin is torn; I swim a little crooked.

lines.zh: 疼让我颜色变淡，这是藏不住的事。
lines.en: Pain pales my colors; that cannot be hidden.

lines.zh: 我躲进珊瑚最深的缝里，等疼过去。
lines.en: I hide in the deepest coral seam until the pain passes.

lines.zh: 你伤了一条小鱼，另外四条都看见了。
lines.en: You hurt one small fish; the other four saw.

lines.zh: 我翻了个身，又挣扎着正过来。
lines.en: I flipped over and struggled upright again.

lines.zh: 这一下让我的条纹断了一截。
lines.en: That broke a segment of my stripe.

lines.zh: 我吐了个泡，泡里全是慌。
lines.en: I blow a bubble, and the bubble is all panic.

lines.zh: 我不叫疼，鱼没有那样的声音。
lines.en: I do not cry out; fish have no such sound.

lines.zh: 我往深处退，那里的水更暗更安全。
lines.en: I retreat deeper, where the water is darker and safer.

lines.zh: 这点伤，换一片珊瑚也值得。
lines.en: This wound is worth a piece of coral.

lines.zh: 你指间漏下的碎屑，够我吃一整天。
lines.en: The crumbs slipping between your fingers could feed me all day.

lines.zh: 我不该靠近的，可那味道太软了。
lines.en: I should not come closer, but that smell is so soft.

lines.zh: 我只吃一口，吃完就回珊瑚里。
lines.en: One bite only, then back into the coral.

lines.zh: 你晃一下手，我的尾就自己摆过去了。
lines.en: Move your hand and my tail turns toward it on its own.

lines.zh: 骨粉的味道像别的鱼留下的骨头。
lines.en: Bone meal tastes like the bones other fish left behind.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的手转，不是亲近，是找角度。
lines.en: I circle your hand not from affection but for an angle.

lines.zh: 那群同伴都退了，只有我还在往前。
lines.en: My school has backed off; only I still advance.

lines.zh: 小个子也有小个子的贪心。
lines.en: Even the small have small greed.

lines.zh: 我把嘴凑近，你别突然合掌。
lines.en: I bring my mouth close; do not suddenly close your hands.

lines.zh: 你给的食物比珊瑚缝里的碎屑好吃太多。
lines.en: Your food beats the scraps in the coral seams by far.

lines.zh: 你的手指把我推得翻了半圈。
lines.en: Your finger spun me half a turn.

lines.zh: 我撞在玻璃上，额头有点钝钝的疼。
lines.en: I hit the glass and my forehead aches dully.

lines.zh: 五条鱼挤在一起，谁也没让谁。
lines.en: Five fish crowd together and none gives way.

lines.zh: 我被水流一推，撞进了珊瑚枝里。
lines.en: A current shoves me into the coral branches.

lines.zh: 你这么硬，撞一下我要缓很久。
lines.en: You are so hard; one bump takes me long to recover.

lines.zh: 我侧身让过你，鳍尖还是擦到了。
lines.en: I turn aside but my fin tip still grazes you.

lines.zh: 别用桶壁挤我，我的鳍很薄。
lines.en: Do not press me against the bucket; my fins are thin.

lines.zh: 撞完我还要装作没事，这是体面。
lines.en: After the bump I must pretend nothing happened; that is dignity.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起时，水花比鱼还大。
lines.en: When we collide the splash is bigger than the fish.

lines.zh: 我退半步，把撞歪的那条纹理顺。
lines.en: I back off half a step and straighten my bent stripe.

lines.zh: 我在她面前把鳍全张开，像一面小旗。
lines.en: I spread every fin before her like a little flag.

lines.zh: 她只看了一眼，我就再张得大一点。
lines.en: She glances once; I spread a little wider.

lines.zh: 我们并排往上游，条纹对着条纹。
lines.en: We rise side by side, stripe facing stripe.

lines.zh: 求偶的颜色要最亮，我连鳍边都透橙。
lines.en: Courtship demands my brightest color; even my fin edges glow orange.

lines.zh: 她绕我转了一圈，我紧张得忘了摆尾。
lines.en: She circles me once and I forget to beat my tail.

lines.zh: 暖水海洋里，配对只要一次同向游动。
lines.en: In warm seas, pairing takes one swim in the same direction.

lines.zh: 我把最好的珊瑚缝让给她，她留下了。
lines.en: I give her the best coral gap and she stays.

lines.zh: 我们两条守着一丛珊瑚，谁都不许靠近。
lines.en: The two of us guard one clump; no one else may come near.

lines.zh: 她的白比我的白干净，我承认。
lines.en: Her white is cleaner than mine; I admit it.

lines.zh: 之后产卵的地方，我早就挑好了。
lines.en: I already chose where the eggs will go.

lines.zh: 水里掉下一粒东西，我用嘴接住了。
lines.en: Something drops through the water and I catch it in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我把它含在嘴里，游了两圈才吞。
lines.en: I hold it in my mouth two laps before deciding to swallow.

lines.zh: 这粒太硬，我吐出来又叼回去。
lines.en: This one is too hard; I spit it out and take it again.

lines.zh: 我不搬东西，我只挑能吃的。
lines.en: I carry nothing; I only pick what can be eaten.

lines.zh: 碎屑卡在珊瑚缝里，我侧身去够。
lines.en: A crumb is wedged in coral; I turn sideways to reach it.

lines.zh: 捡东西的时候我顾不上看周围。
lines.en: While picking things up I forget to watch around me.

lines.zh: 这条小鱼居然在囤食，说出去没人信。
lines.en: A fish this small hoarding food; no one would believe it.

lines.zh: 我叼着它游回洞里，路上差点掉了。
lines.en: I carry it back to the hollow and nearly drop it.

lines.zh: 掉在沙上的那点，比漂着的香。
lines.en: What falls to the sand smells better than what drifts.

lines.zh: 我嘴里塞满了，还是想再捡一粒。
lines.en: My mouth is full and I still want one more.

lines.zh: 那团浮游比别的都密，我盯上了它。
lines.en: That plankton cluster is denser than the rest; I want it.

lines.zh: 有东西在珊瑚缝里动，很小，正好。
lines.en: Something moves in the coral seam, tiny, just right.

lines.zh: 我锁定了一粒，就不再管整片水。
lines.en: I fix on one grain and ignore the whole sea.

lines.zh: 这条虫比我短，我有把握。
lines.en: This worm is shorter than me; I am confident.

lines.zh: 它抢了我的碎屑，我记住它了。
lines.en: It stole my crumb; I have noted it.

lines.zh: 我把身体转向它，鳍全部收紧。
lines.en: I turn my body toward it, fins pulled tight.

lines.zh: 目标不需要大，只需要跑得慢。
lines.en: A target need not be big, only slow.

lines.zh: 它躲进珊瑚，那正是我最熟的地方。
lines.en: It hides in the coral, which is exactly where I know best.

lines.zh: 我决定追，虽然我只有一根手指长。
lines.en: I decide to chase, though I am one finger long.

lines.zh: 这条小鱼今天脾气不好，别挡我。
lines.en: This small fish is in a bad mood today; do not block me.

lines.zh: 我贴着珊瑚枝游，一点点缩短距离。
lines.en: I skim the coral branches, closing the gap bit by bit.

lines.zh: 它一动我就停，让它以为水是静的。
lines.en: When it moves I stop, letting it think the water is still.

lines.zh: 我从上方压下去，那里光最亮。
lines.en: I press down from above, where the light is brightest.

lines.zh: 我的条纹在珊瑚里正好是伪装。
lines.en: In coral my stripes are perfect camouflage.

lines.zh: 它的尾巴一摆，我就知道它要往左。
lines.en: One tail flick and I know it will go left.

lines.zh: 我不叫也不追快，我只等它累。
lines.en: I make no sound, chase no faster; I wait for it to tire.

lines.zh: 这么小的身体，扑空一次就白费力气。
lines.en: A body this small cannot afford to miss once.

lines.zh: 我绕到它背后，那里它看不见我。
lines.en: I circle behind it, where it cannot see me.

lines.zh: 暖水让我的动作轻，几乎不搅沙。
lines.en: Warm water makes me light; I barely stir the sand.

lines.zh: 再等一拍，等它离开珊瑚的掩护。
lines.en: One more beat, until it leaves the coral's cover.

lines.zh: 我这一撞，大概只有一粒沙的分量。
lines.en: My strike carries about the weight of a grain of sand.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的鳍，它甩两下就挣脱。
lines.en: I bite its fin; two shakes and it pulls free.

lines.zh: 别笑，小鱼的牙齿也是牙齿。
lines.en: Do not laugh; a small fish's teeth are still teeth.

lines.zh: 我撞它的侧腹，那里最软。
lines.en: I ram its flank, the softest part.

lines.zh: 这一口只够撕下一小片，但够了。
lines.en: This bite only tears a sliver, but that is enough.

lines.zh: 我攻击完立刻退进珊瑚，从不逗留。
lines.en: I strike and retreat into coral, never staying put.

lines.zh: 它比我大十倍，可它转不过来。
lines.en: It is ten times my size and cannot turn fast enough.

lines.zh: 我专咬眼睛旁边那一圈。
lines.en: I go for the ring just beside the eye.

lines.zh: 这一下是为了让它记住我的颜色。
lines.en: This is so it remembers my colors.

lines.zh: 我小小的，但我的攻击从不迟。
lines.en: I am small, but my strike is never late.

lines.zh: 我从卵里出来时，只有一粒米大。
lines.en: I came out of the egg the size of a grain of rice.

lines.zh: 暖水海洋第一道光，照在我透明的鳍上。
lines.en: The warm sea's first light fell on my clear fins.

lines.zh: 我们一群五条，从同一丛珊瑚里散开。
lines.en: Five of us fanned out from the same coral clump.

lines.zh: 我出生就会游，但还不会停。
lines.en: I could swim at birth, but not yet hover.

lines.zh: 珊瑚的缝隙就是我的第一条路。
lines.en: A coral gap was my first road.

lines.zh: 那时候我的条纹还没长全，只有两道。
lines.en: My stripes were incomplete then, only two.

lines.zh: 大鱼从我头顶游过，我贴住礁石不动。
lines.en: A big fish passed overhead; I pressed to the reef.

lines.zh: 我太小了，连浪都推得动我。
lines.en: I was so small even the swell could push me.

lines.zh: 这片暖水会一直暖下去，我赌这个。
lines.en: This warm water will stay warm; I am betting on it.

lines.zh: 我落进珊瑚丛，从此这里叫家。
lines.en: I settled into the coral; this place has been home since.

lines.zh: 水一下子烫了，我的鳍立刻卷起来。
lines.en: The water turns hot and my fins curl at once.

lines.zh: 我从水面掉下来，摔在礁石上弹了一下。
lines.en: I fall from the surface and bounce once off the reef.

lines.zh: 我在水里，却也会有喘不上气的时候。
lines.en: I live in water and still can gasp for breath.

lines.zh: 一声闷响，珊瑚碎成了白沙。
lines.en: A muffled blast and the coral becomes white sand.

lines.zh: 那根细刺穿过水，扎进我的侧腹。
lines.en: The thin barb crossed the water and pierced my flank.

lines.zh: 紫色的光一罩，我的方向感全乱了。
lines.en: Purple light falls and my sense of direction scatters.

lines.zh: 礁上三天没有浮游，我的肚子贴着背。
lines.en: Three days without plankton; my belly touches my back.

lines.zh: 雷落进海里，整片暖水都白了一下。
lines.en: Lightning enters the sea and the warm water flashes white.

lines.zh: 珊瑚没有了，水没有了，只剩下坠。
lines.en: No coral, no water, only the fall.
